explanation.text: A process monitor has flagged an abnormal condition triggered by the T2 statistic, which is 3.6 times its alarm threshold. The primary instruments responsible for this deviation are XMEAS(9) Reactor temperature, XMEAS(21) Reactor cooling water outlet temperature, and XMEAS(14) Product separator underflow (stream 10). Check XMEAS(21) Reactor cooling water outlet temperature first as it shows the most significant deviation.
